segments.text: We first tried WhatsApp Business in 206. At the time, market pressure mattered because competitors moved online and took some market share.
The biggest issue was Policy uncertainty. Without steady power in Enugu, costs kept rising.
Our sales changed after WhatsApp Business—we saw Better cashflow visibility within 4 months.
Policy-wise, Tax compliance shaped our move. We adjusted by Peer learning.
Data helped; even a low-code AutoML gave us clearer demand patterns during New Year.
